SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TARGET AS PLANT , KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO , KEY_2 AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , KEY_3 AS LEGACY_GR_NO , KEY_4 AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ FROM KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GR' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY PLANT,KEY_3,KEY_4,KEY_1,KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'CHSG' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, ISNULL(STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, LEGACY_PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, LEGACY_PO_COUNT AS REF_IF_NO, ISNULL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE, ISNULL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(GR_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY, ISNULL(GR_AMT,0) AS GR_AMT, ISNULL(GR_DATE,' ') AS GR_DATE, ISNULL(LEGACY_PR_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, LEGACY_GR_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO, LEGACY_GR_SEQ AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, ISNULL(RO_QTY,0) AS RO_QTY, ISNULL(RO_AMT,0) AS RO_AMT, ISNULL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK , ISNULL(PLANT,' ') as PLANT FROM V_KEP_GR WHERE isnull(PLANT,' ') = isnull('$G_RS.PLANT$',' ') AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ= '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND LEGACY_GR_SEQ= '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$' ORDER BY PLANT, LEGACY_GR_NO,LEGACY_GR_SEQ, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', KEY_6 = GETDATE() WHERE DOC_NAME= 'GR' AND isnull(TARGET,' ') = isnull('$G_RS.PLANT$',' ') AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$'
UPDATE KEPTRXL SET IF_FLAG = 'E', KEY_6 = GETDATE() WHERE DOC_NAME= 'GR' AND isnull(TARGET,' ') = isnull('$G_RS.PLANT$',' ') AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_SEQ$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND KEY_4 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$'
